name: Sanoma Oyj

name: TXT e-solutions SpA

name: Transcosmos Inc

name: TIS Inc

name: Laureate Education Inc
rationale: Laureate's core tuition-based online and campus degrees face debated substitution by AI tutors and generative learning tools, pressuring enrolment and pricing over the period.

name: Ad-sol Nissin Corp

name: Palantir Technologies Inc
rationale: Sells AI software platforms (AIP, Foundry) to governments and enterprises; AI adoption drives its commercial growth, and it is not mainly selling AI infrastructure.

name: TOTVS SA
rationale: Sells AI agents embedded in ERP, payroll and fintech suites, supporting upsell and pricing, though seat-based substitution risk is debated.

name: 3billion Inc
rationale: Inferred from name and sector: AI-driven genetic analysis and diagnostics could materially improve a health-care testing product's accuracy and pricing, though details are unverified.

name: Nemetschek SE
rationale: Sells BIM and CAD design software for architecture, engineering and construction; AI features can lift productivity and pricing, though seat-based substitution risk is debated.

name: Zeta Global Holdings Corp
rationale: Zeta sells an AI-driven marketing cloud whose predictive audience targeting and generative content tools improve client campaign performance and pricing, a central five-year growth driver.

name: Crowdstrike Holdings Inc
rationale: AI-driven threat detection and agentic SOC tools in its Falcon platform could expand demand and pricing, though some seat-based software substitution debate remains.

name: Kingsoft Corp Ltd
rationale: WPS Office AI features and AI-driven game and cloud services could lift product pricing and engagement, though the revenue mix is spread across segments.

name: Palo Alto Networks Inc
rationale: Sells AI-powered security platforms and products for securing enterprise AI use, so AI adds to product demand and pricing; not selling AI infrastructure itself.

name: Dynatrace Inc
rationale: Dynatrace sells AI-driven observability software; growing AI workloads and its Davis AI engine raise demand and pricing, with limited substitution risk to its core platform.

name: RoboSense Technology Co Ltd
rationale: Sells lidar perception sensors for ADAS, autonomous driving and robotics; AI perception demand drives volume, though it is sensor hardware rather than core AI infrastructure.

name: Upstart Holdings Inc
rationale: Upstart's AI underwriting models drive loan approvals, pricing and conversion for bank partners, so AI is central to its lending marketplace and net effect is positive.

name: Kuaishou Technology
rationale: AI recommendation and ad-targeting lift short-video engagement and advertising monetisation, with Kling generative video models adding upside, though core growth still rests on platform traffic.

name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals Inc

name: Septeni Holdings Co Ltd
rationale: Its digital ad agency business uses AI for ad targeting, optimisation and creative tools that can improve performance and margins, though generative AI could also compress agency labour.
